title: Catalyst System Efficiency Below Threshold (Bank 1)
shortDescription: Catalyst efficiency on bank 1 is below the required threshold.
fullDescription:
P0420 indicates the post-catalyst oxygen sensor signal is mirroring the pre-catalyst sensor too closely, meaning the catalyst is not converting emissions efficiently.

Common causes are a degraded catalytic converter, fuel contamination, or a failing oxygen sensor. The MIL will illuminate and the vehicle may fail emissions testing.
safetyImpact: Vehicle is drivable; emissions are out of compliance.

fixSteps.title: Scan and freeze frame
fixSteps.instruction: Pull DTCs and review O2 sensor activity.

fixSteps.title: Address misfires first
fixSteps.instruction: Resolve any misfire codes before replacing the catalyst.

fixSteps.title: Test O2 sensors
fixSteps.instruction: Compare pre and post-cat sensor waveforms.

fixSteps.title: Replace catalyst
fixSteps.instruction: Install OEM-spec catalytic converter.

faq.a: Yes — emissions-related codes typically cause an inspection failure until cleared.

title: Catalyst Temperature Sensor (Bank 1)
shortDescription: Catalyst temperature sensor fault on bank 1.
fullDescription:
P0425 sets when the ECM detects an issue with the catalyst temperature sensor signal, voltage out of range, or implausible readings.

Sensor faults can affect closed-loop fueling decisions and catalyst protection strategies.
safetyImpact: Drivable, but emissions monitoring is impaired.

fixSteps.instruction: Retrieve DTCs and freeze frame.

shortDescription: Catalyst heater control circuit fault on bank 1.

Open/shorted heater circuits or a failed relay are common causes.
safetyImpact: Drivable; cold-start emissions elevated.

title: Evaporative Emission Control System
shortDescription: Evaporative emission system fault detected.
fullDescription:
P0440 indicates a fault within the EVAP system, which captures fuel vapors from the tank and routes them to the engine to be burned.

Common issues include a loose or failed gas cap, leaking hoses, failed purge or vent valve, or a cracked charcoal canister.
safetyImpact: Drivable; emissions impact only.

fixSteps.instruction: Confirm gas cap clicks and seals.

fixSteps.title: Smoke test
fixSteps.instruction: Smoke-test the EVAP system to find leaks.

fixSteps.title: Replace failed valve
fixSteps.instruction: Replace purge or vent valve as required.
